title: QA run · release-18.2.0-w2-manual-browser (34/34) · 756220c4 · 2026-10-27 · 30 PASS / 3 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
This is the QA run record for card W2-C3b of the 18.2.0 release sweep, wave 2 (wave anchor #25807; Version Packages PR #25640): the manual set, browser/mixed surface. It was run with the `checklist-test` skill following `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` and the `dogfood-verification` skill. The maintainer ordered this wave directly as a test run; lane/seat dispatch protocol does not apply.

The scope is the unpinned P1 items whose `source[]` cites a file changed by a `Clause-②: yes` changeset in #25640, with P0 excluded (card W2-C1 owns P0). The set was named on the card, not resolved by one selector. Each id was resolved on its own with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ID --json`. All 34 came back runnable: none is blocked, none is `planned`, and none carries an `automated.ref`, so every clause was driven live. Every item has a verdict (34/34).

This record supersedes, for the 16 items it shares with it, the wave-1 manual-set record #25817 (old head `6679644a`). The other 13 items of #25817 belong to the sibling card W2-C3a. Under the card's supersede protocol, whichever of the two cards finishes second closes #25817. When this record was filed, W2-C3a had filed no record, so #25817 stays open and the close is left to W2-C3a (see the close-out comment).

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `756220c4a7adcbb1228864607cb4b6a1ca486dc0`, checked out detached. The tree was clean before and after. `git status` stayed empty throughout, and no runner wrote to the tree.
  - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` passed in 34 s.
  - `pnpm build --concurrency=2` passed 119/119 in about 14 min.
  - `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` was green: 108 package build artifacts present.
  - The tree is unreleased, so the CLI reports `@objectstack/cli/18.1.0`.
- **Console build:** built in-repo from `ui/` at that same commit. `pnpm build` built `@object-ui/console` (`packages/console/dist/index.html` 01:44Z). `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` then ran as a cache hit, 72/72 (71 cached). The `.objectui-sha` pin and `pnpm objectui:build` are retired. Every console observation was against this build, which rules out `stale-console-bundle`.
- **App and boot:** `examples/app-showcase`, booted with the canonical line `OS_PORT=PORT setsid pnpm -C …/examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:SCRATCH/BOOT.db`.
  - Every boot had its own free port in 43100–43700 and its own file DB.
  - Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) plus the showcase seed (132 rows; banner `32 flow(s) 19 bound · 8 draft`).
  - Every server was stopped by process group, and a final `lsof` sweep found no listeners.
- **Special boots:**
  - `--no-seed-admin` with `OS_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true` on a fresh DB: first-run owner bootstrap.
  - `OS_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true`: the signup-gate toggle leg.
  - `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=capability`: probe only.
  - `OS_SEARCH_PINYIN_ENABLED=false`: the pinyin OFF leg.
  - `SHOWCASE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` set: the webhook intake leg of the node-type matrix.
  - A reboot with `OS_LOCALIZATION_TIMEZONE=Europe/Paris` and `OS_MAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD`: the settings env-lock legs and webhook activation survival.
  - An app-todo `--preset minimal` scratch copy: the messaging-absent 501 leg.
  - Scratch app copies (tar, without `node_modules`, `.objectstack` or `dist`): the capability shadow/malformed apps and the retired-webhook-trigger builds.
  - A published scaffold: `npx -y create-objectstack@latest`, which resolved to 18.1.0 through the proxy.
  - `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED` was not needed by any clause.
- **Tree side effects:** `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` never existed. `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/data/` appeared, empty, at the first boot (01:46:41Z), although every boot passed `-d file:…`. It is gitignored, and no runner installed a package.
- **Browser:** Playwright chromium build 1243 (matching `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1243`), launched with `chromium.launch()` and default options. Each persona had its own context and signed in through the form, with both the localStorage `auth-session-token` and the `better-auth.session_token` cookie confirmed and the identity proven via `GET /auth/get-session`. At most three runners used a browser at once, and each held at most one browser instance.
- **Execution:** six runner subagents, each with its own port range and DBs, ran in two staggered waves, never more than three at once. The batches were:
  - A: approvals
  - B: automation and formula
  - C: identity and access
  - D: studio-authoring and the permission matrix
  - E: records, search and UX
  - F: i18n, integration, settings, cli and audit

  Items ran sequentially inside each batch. The model tier was the default (opus): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` gives no path-derived mandate for this surface. The coordinator re-verified each extracted defect independently on a boot of its own (port 43700) or against the built package.
- **Wall clock:** 01:29Z to 03:00Z (UTC, 2026-10-27).

**Derived: 30 PASS / 3 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** One clause failed: `ux-conventions.write-feedback` A1. Its reproduction rule is below, and it is a product defect in the showcase fixture's copy, extracted. There is no authentication or authorization finding, so nothing is withheld.

**The #25822 retest** (`i18n.strict-translation-key-rejection`, a probe beside the clauses that scores no clause):
- **The fix holds** for the exact reproduction. `PUT /api/v1/meta/translation/qa_bad_locale` with `locale: "not a locale!!"` → 422 `INVALID_METADATA` (path `locale`, `invalid_format`), and the read-back is 404.
- It also holds for `zh_CN`, for a value padded on either side, and for multi-word names (`Simplified Chinese`), at both the save door and `defineTranslation` / `defineTranslationBundle`. The control `zh-CN` saves 200.
- **One residual:** a single-word language name of 2–8 letters (`Chinese`, `English`, `Japanese`) still saves 200 `_diagnostics.valid:true` and is accepted by both define functions. The changeset and the refusal text both say "a language name" is refused. This is extracted as its own card (see the close-out); it does not reopen #25822.

## Per-clause evidence (one line per clause; text oracles)

### approvals.per-group-signoff (rev 10) · PASS
- A0 pass: EXP-2001 reads `pending`.
  - `pending_approvers` holds two distinct ids (the admin and `usr_showcase_auditor_demo`).
  - `pending_approver_groups` maps admin→[manager] and Ada→[finance].
  - `decision_progress` per_group reads got 0 need 2, and the run is `paused` at `dual_signoff`.
- A1 pass: the admin approves through the request page's dialog: `POST …/approve` → 200.
  - The request stays `pending`, and the slate is [Ada].
  - The groups read manager 1/1 `satisfied:true` and finance 0/1.
- A2 pass: the chips match the API at all three stages: "0 of 2 groups" with finance 0/1 and manager 0/1, then "1 of 2 groups" with manager ✓, then Approved with no chips.
- A3 pass: Ada, in her own session, approves → 200 `approved`.
  - The run goes paused → `completed` with [start, dual_signoff, mark_approved], and there is no return_to_draft step.
  - The report reads `approved`.
- A4 pass: `/actions` holds submit, approve (admin) and approve (Ada), with `via_override:false` on both approves.
- A5 pass: the admin's approve carrying `actorId` set to Ada → 403 FORBIDDEN "cannot act as …", and no row is written. With no `actorId` → 200, recorded against the session user.
- N0 pass: unanimous INV-1012 (need 1) finalizes on one approve; per-group needed two.
- N1 pass: Mei (in neither group) approving → 403 "not a pending approver", and no row is written.

### approvals.quorum-m-of-n (rev 7) · PASS
The verdict rests on the runtime fixture, not the clamp. On a fresh boot:
- Ada was bound to finance and Lena Legal (QA) to legal through `sys_user_position` (201 each). Lena was minted by invite then sign-up.
- `showcase_expense_signoff` was toggled off and back on.
- Two submitted reports (QA-Q1, QA-Q2) each carry a 6000 line. Each slate holds 3 distinct holders, with quorum got 0 need 2.

Clauses:
- A0 pass (clamp contrast): EXP-DEMO need 1 finalizes on one approve, with exactly one approve row.
- A1 pass: Q1 goes 0/2 → 1/2 (Ada's approve in the UI) → `approved` (Lena's approve in the UI).
  - There are 2 approve rows from 2 distinct actors.
  - The run completed with mark_approved.
- A2 pass: on Q2, Ada approves (1/2), then Lena rejects in the UI → 200 `rejected`.
  - The slate empties, the run completes with return_to_draft, and the report reads `draft`.
  - A later approve → 409 INVALID_STATE.
- A3 pass: after Q1 finalizes, `pending_approvers=[]` and the third holder is dropped.
  - The admin's My Pending count goes 4 → 3.
  - `?approverId=…&status=pending` no longer lists Q1.
- A4 pass: the page tally matches the API at each stage: "Approvals — 0 of 2 · 3 eligible approvers", then "1 of 2 · 2 eligible approvers", then Approved.
- N0 pass: Ada's repeat approve and Mei's approve (no position) each → 403, and the tally holds at 1/2.
- N1 pass: the clamp is not scored as M-of-N.

- A1 pass:
  - The admin's own INV-1012 adds Send reminder and Recall.
  - The member's view of EXP-DEMO has neither.
  - The admin (override actor) on EXP-DEMO gets Override Approve/Reject/Reassign/Recall and no Send reminder.
- A2 pass: the viewer flags predict each rendered set exactly from the declared CEL `visible` expressions:
  - member/EXP-DEMO: can_act T, is_submitter F, can_override F
  - admin/EXP-DEMO: F, F, T
  - admin/INV: T, T, T
- A3 pass:
  - The member's Approve click → `POST …/approve` 200, and the request is `approved`.
  - The admin's Send reminder → `POST …/remind` 200, and the request stays pending.
- A4 pass: one new `approve` row (the member) and one new `remind` row (the admin).
- N0 pass: no button rendered against a denying flag in any of the three (viewer, request) pairs.

### approvals.decision-action-matrix (rev 9) · PARTIAL
- A0 pass: all nine variants → 200, and each appends exactly one `/:id/actions` row naming its actor and action. The variants are approve, reject, revise, resubmit, recall, remind, reassign, request-info (by the reassigned approver) and comment. The maxRevisions revise appends the designed [revise, reject "Auto-rejected: revision limit (2) exceeded"] pair.
- A1 pass:
  - EXP-DEMO goes pending → approved, and its run goes paused → completed.
  - A budget reject (210000) → `rejected`, and its run has no needs_exec step.
  - A budget approve (160000) → `approved`, with a `needs_exec` step.
- A2 pass: revise → `returned`, and the run pauses at `wait_revision`.
- A3 pass:
  - A resubmit by a non-submitter → 403 "only the submitter may resubmit".
  - The submitter's resubmit → 200, a new pending id on the same `flow_run_id` / `flow_node_id=manager_review`.
- A4 pass: R1 still reads `returned` after R2 opens.
- A5 pass: the third revise → 200 `rejected`, and the run completes.
- A6 pass:
  - A recall by a non-submitter → 403.
  - The submitter's recall → `recalled`, the slate empties and the run completes.
  - The request leaves `?status=pending&approverId=…`.
- A7 pass: reassign moves the slate [admin, admin] → [Ada, Ada] and the request stays pending. After remind, request-info and comment, the status, progress, slate and current-step snapshots are byte-identical, with one new row each.
- A8 pass: a project PATCH under manager_review (lockRecord:false) → 200. Under exec_review (lockRecord:true) → 409 RECORD_LOCKED.
- A9 blocked(fixture, knownGaps[0]): still no stock door mints an org-less request at `756220c4`.
  - `approval-service.ts` sets `requestOrg = subjectOrg ?? ctxOrg`.
  - The REST ledger has no submit door.
  - No stock flow pairs an approval node with a schedule, time-relative or api trigger.
- N0 pass: revise at exec_review → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED "no 'revise' out-edge", with no row written.
- N1 pass: a second remind → 429 THROTTLED, with no row written.
- N2 pass: every wrong-relationship call → 403 with no row written (recall/resubmit by a non-submitter; request-info after reassigning away; request-info, comment, approve and reassign by an outsider; remind by a non-submitter).

### automation.flow-run-step-nesting (rev 8) · PASS

  - start and loop_tasks have no parent.
- A2 pass: the nested fan-out over 2 rows gives (iteration, branch) pairs (0,0), (0,1), (1,0) and (1,1), each once, with `branch:0` present. All 18 steps parse under the built `ExecutionStepLogSchema`.
- A3 pass: the Studio Runs tab renders a nested tree, not a flat one: "For each task LOOP" → ITERATION 1/2/3 → TRY_CATCH → TRY → Send Reminder.
- A4 pass: the panel shows 8 step rows, matching the 8 API steps, with the same grouping.

### automation.flow-node-type-matrix (rev 9) · PASS
- A0 pass: `GET /automation/actions` returns 19 ids (the 21 variants minus start and end). The Add-node palette on a clone lists the same 19 plus End.
- A1 pass: every variant was evidenced by a real run step: start, decision, get_record, delete_record, assignment, loop, create_record, update_record, http, notify, script, screen, wait, subflow, map, connector_action, parallel, try_catch, approval, approval_revise, and end.
  - create_record came from a signed webhook post (202).
  - http came from the knownGaps self-ping recipe.
  - connector_action came from the self-ping connector with `OS_PORT` exported.
  - end is evidenced by 25 completed runs.
  - A skipped end, and an http to an egress-blocked host, were not cited.
- A2 pass: each suspending variant read paused before and completed after: screen (reassign wizard), wait (60 s hold), approval, approval_revise and map.
- A3 pass: a sweep of 35 flows / 34 runs / 104 steps found 0 steps with an empty or missing nodeType.
- A4 pass: loop-body, parallel-branch, try and catch regions each carry parentNodeId and regionKind.
- A5 pass: an unknown node type `bogus_node`:

  - logs a WARN with `unknownTypes:["bogus_node"]`;
  - its trigger → 400 FLOW_FAILED "No executor registered for node type 'bogus_node'";

- N0 pass: the unknown type was not silent.
